text:
maya: Heads-up — launching a small pilot for SI onboarding next month. Goal: 2 SI teams, hands-on lab access, and a light certification badge they can show to customers. who can help run the trainer sessions?

alex: I can take 2 trainer sessions (intro + infra deep dive). need module outlines.

ron: happy to run the HW setup lab. i'll coordinate on GPU images and marketplace AMIs.

sophie: I'll draft the certification rubric (pass/fail + lab checklist). want it to be <2 hours to complete.

joel: marketing can do a co-branded announcement if pilot hits >1 SI launch by EOM. timeline?

maya: thx. proposed timeline: recruit SIs by 4/10, run pilot 4/22-4/25, cert eval 4/26, decision 4/29. is that tight? :thinking_face:

alex: tight but doable. need training slides + lab infra by 4/12. can reuse parts of devex workshop.

ron: infra checklist: 1) marketplace images available 2) sample VPC terraform 3) hardware matrix (A100 vs H100) 4) KV cache sample data. I'll spin AMIs by 4/9.

sophie: certification rubric draft: items = [basic deploy, latency test <150ms p50, run eval suite on sample prompt set, demo rollback]. pass = 3/4. will share doc.

joel: for the announcement we need a co-sell opt-in form for SIs and a partner logo asset pack. i'll share a short form.

maya: also want a trainer-led lab playbook (runbook) + an async version for SI enablement teams. alex — can you own the async course?

alex: yes, i'll create a 25-30 minute self-paced module + quiz. content: overview, infra checklist, quick debugging, best practices, cost tuning.

maya: onboard-bot — please register these action items in the partnerships tracker.

onboard-bot: Action created: SI Onboarding Pilot #177532 — owners: alex, ron, sophie, joel — due 2026-04-12. Link: https://redwood.internal/partners/tracker/177532

ron: question: hardware partner ask — can we include an H100 loaner program for the pilot? OEM needs a partner brief. who drafts it?

sophie: i'll draft the brief. target audience: partner AMs and procurement. include sample SLA matrix.

maya: decision on public-facing cert badge: we want a lightweight "Redwood SI Verified" svg and a cert landing page. design ops can mock — joel pls request assets.

joel: will ping design and sequence the announcement with product marketing. rough draft copy by 4/20.

alex: for the labs, include a short troubleshooting snippet in the docs:
```bash
# fetch sample model and run inference smoke test
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"open-rlhf-v1","input":"hello"}'
```

maya: perfect. next sync Wed 4/7 10am PT to lock enrollments and confirm AMIs. I'll create calendar invite.

ron: counted in. I'll add the hardware partner contact to the invite.

sophie: adding evaluation prompts to the shared drive now.

joel: adding co-marketing checklist to the drive too.

maya: great work team — want one committed SI success story from the pilot to greenlight 1:many enablement. let's keep it lean. :sparkles:
